validation.generic_reference_integrity_boundary: Known repository-global missing tools/research_scheduler.py; unrelated to this package

theorems.name: Internal six-state rotor
theorems.statement: G=I+R satisfies G^2=R, G^3=-I, G^6=I and G^TQG=Q.

theorems.name: Unique Cell-radius gate normalization
theorems.statement: (I+G)^TQ(I+G)=3Q, hence the unique positive scalar a for which a(I+G) preserves Q is a=1/sqrt(3), equal to the current Cell radius.

theorems.name: Twelve-state gate rotor
theorems.statement: H=(I+G)/sqrt(3) satisfies H^2=G, H^6=-I, H^12=I; its twelve powers are distinct and H^(2j),H^(2j+1) interleave six direction and six gate character phases.

theorems.name: Cell-radius chiral complex structure
theorems.statement: J=H^3=(R-R^{-1})/sqrt(3) and J^2=-I. Reflection R<->R^{-1} sends J<->-J while fixing -I.

theorems.name: Operator-state distinction
theorems.statement: J exists as a C3 representation operator, whereas a quarter-turn state first occurs in the C12 Cell-gate refinement and is represented by H^3.

theorems.name: Normalized-bisector square-root theorem
theorems.statement: For a unit U != -1 in a two-dimensional real commutative rotation algebra, beta(U)=(1+U)/sqrt(2+U+U^{-1}) is unit and beta(U)^2=U; the positive-scalar root is unique.

theorems.name: First two bisectors are native-selected
theorems.statement: G=beta(R) and H=beta(G); the second normalizer is exactly the Cell radius 1/sqrt(3).

theorems.name: Unique J-invariant character norm
theorems.statement: A positive quadratic form q on span_R{I,J} with q(I)=1 and q(Jx)=q(x) is q(aI+bJ)=a^2+b^2.

theorems.name: Viète trace recursion
theorems.statement: Repeated forward normalized bisectors U_(n+1)^2=U_n yield c_(n+1)=sqrt((1+c_n)/2) and P_n=2^n s_n=2/prod_{j=2}^n c_j.

theorems.name: Internal unit-speed scale
theorems.statement: The increasing bounded P_n has a finite positive limit L and (U_n-I)/(L/2^n) -> J; L is therefore the scale making the completed flow unit speed.

theorems.name: Euler completion
theorems.statement: The dyadic character E0(kL/2^n)=U_n^k extends uniquely to the continuous one-parameter subgroup E(t)=exp(tJ); under J=i its compatible forward-root tower selects the first half-period, classical pi, and E(L)=-I.

theorems.name: Native Pythagorean segment-spinor identity
theorems.statement: For v=a+bJ and n=a^2+b^2, the projective rotation character C[a:b]=((a^2-b^2)+2abJ)/n equals (v/sqrt(n))^2. For a>0, beta(C[a:b])=v/sqrt(n). In particular C[1:0]=1, C[1:1]=J, and C[0:1]=-1.

theorems.name: Physical gate displacement
theorems.statement: The unit gate-ray character is H=r(I+G), while the carrier-character image of the physical triple-intersection gate displacement is rH=(I+G)/3. Equivalently 3(rH)=I+G under 3r^2=1.

theorems.name: Finite Cayley half-turn certificate
theorems.statement: For tau_n=s_n/(1+c_n), U_n=(1+J tau_n)/(1-J tau_n) and ((1+J tau_n)/(1-J tau_n))^(2^n)=-1 at every finite depth.

theorems.name: Target-free two-sided period squeeze
theorems.statement: P_n=2^n s_n increases, Q_n=2^(n+1) tau_n decreases, P_n<Q_n, both have a common limit L, and Q_n-P_n=P_n tau_n^2; in particular 2<L<4.

theorems.name: Finite Cayley certificates complete to the Euler exponential
theorems.statement: Writing Q_n=2^(n+1)tau_n, the exact identities C(Q_n/2^(n+1))^(2^n)=-1 converge under the standard Cayley-to-exponential limit to exp(JL)=-1; the forward first-winding normalization identifies L with classical pi.

negative_boundaries: The character matrices are not identified with the native Enterprise metric plane or the P000 six native axes.
The unit gate-ray phase H is not the physical gate displacement; the latter is represented as rH in the carrier-character readout.
Only the first C6-to-C12 refinement is realized by one-step Cell/gate incidence; deeper roots are transition-history states unless separately realized.
No global operation-safe factorization of every admissible native Cell trajectory to this phase tower is claimed or required for the local pivoted theorem.
Without chirality, the sign of J is not canonical.
Without unit-speed normalization, finite cyclic roots alone do not determine a numerical real period.
The spinor character doubles a typed component direction; it is not a carrier-angle identity.
No six-gate derivation of the ordinary scalar exponent six in the N=58 defect product is claimed.
